Message: A bucket with 'AccessControl' set should also have at least one 'OwnershipControl' configured

Rule.Description: When using AccessControl other than private you must also configure OwnershipControls. The default is bucket owner enforced which disables ACLs.
Rule.ShortDescription: Validate AccessControl are set with OwnershipControls

Message: 'AccessControl' is a legacy property. Consider using 'AWS::S3::BucketPolicy' instead

Rule.Description: Nearly all access control configurations can be more successfully achieved with bucket policies. Consider using bucket policies instead of access control.
Rule.ShortDescription: Controlling access to an S3 bucket should be done with bucket policies

Message: 99999999 is greater than the maximum of 1209600

Rule.Description: Check numbers (integers and floats) for its value being between the minimum and maximum
Rule.ShortDescription: Check if a number is between min and max
